description: This PHP source file 'platformsImport.php' manages the import of platform data into the TestLink application. It includes functions for initializing request arguments, setting up the GUI, handling file uploads (particularly XML files), parsing the uploaded XML to update or create platform records, and utility functions for access rights. It also requires several external PHP scripts for configuration, common functions, and XML handling.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates request arguments related to test project ID, user, and retrieves test project name from database.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI configuration and properties for the import platform page, including URLs, titles, and limits.

methods.name: doImport
methods.description: Handles the import process for uploaded XML files, updating or creating platform entries in the database based on XML content.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to manage platforms.
